Research notes (as of Monday, Oct 12, 2026):

- Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada. He is the 24th prime minister and took office on 14 March 2025 (Wikipedia, List of prime ministers of Canada).
- The official PM website (pm.gc.ca) backs this up. It says he was elected Liberal Party leader and sworn in as Prime Minister in March 2025. The same site's home page lists news items from October 7–11, 2026. One of them is that Prime Minister Carney spoke with US President Donald Trump on October 11, 2026. So he was still in office as of yesterday.
- The Wikipedia page for Mark Carney was updated about a day ago. It lists him as the incumbent for 2025–present, and says he preceded by Justin Trudeau as PM and Liberal leader. That means Trudeau is his predecessor.
- One result, study.com, still names Justin Trudeau as current PM. That page is outdated and conflicts with the official government site, so I'm disregarding it.
